definitions.explanation: A hollow space inside something, such as a cavity in a tree, underground, or in a structure.

definitions.gloss: hollowness; emptiness; being hollow in substance
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe something that has lost its substance or meaning, leaving only an empty shell.

examples.english: There was a hollow in the tree trunk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{空洞|くうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A large cavity was found underground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{空洞|くうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、{陥没|かんぼつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a cavity under the road, and there's a risk of it caving in.

⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流出|りゅうしゅつ}→流出：13327_ryuushutsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空洞化|くうどうか}→空洞化：08025_kuudouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空洞化|くうどうか}→空洞化：08025_kuudouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促進|そくしん}する→促進する：19632_sokushinsuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to promote domestic investment to prevent the hollowing out of industry.

notes:
{空洞|くうどう} combines ⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (empty) and {洞|どう} (cave, cavity).

The derived form ⟦{空洞化|くうどうか}→空洞化：08025_kuudouka⟧ (hollowing out) is very common in news and economics, referring to the loss of substance in organizations, industries, or institutions — particularly when manufacturing moves overseas (⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空洞化|くうどうか}→空洞化：08025_kuudouka⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空洞|くうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (a cavity forms)
- ⟦{空洞化|くうどうか}→空洞化：08025_kuudouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become hollowed out)
- ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空洞化|くうどうか}→空洞化：08025_kuudouka⟧ (industrial hollowing out)
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧{空洞|くうどう} (underground cavity)
